query: What do Samsung Galaxy S9 Plus buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?

rows.text: Worked fine in india with two sims. The mobile workes just fine without any issue with carrier in India

Not unlocked, wont work with my carrier. Phone isn't unlocked like they claim, told me it needed an update and the phone won't update shows error, they won't exchange it and they told me to go to a repair shop...

Carrier unlocked!. I am just leaving a review on whether the phone is unlocked or not. You can get reviews on the actual device all over the internet. But, I assure you when this phone is sold directly from Amazon, it is unlocked. You do not have to use the Simple Mobile SIM/service that is included. I successfully used my AT&T SIM card. I can't guarantee it will work on CDMA since I don't have a CDMA SIM to test.

2 phone numbers?! now I can text myself!. Its advertised tdd hat it doesn't work with CDMA carriers such as virgin mobile. That's false. It works for me in canada and I have a virgin sim. It's really great to have dual sims as well. I have my Canadian sim and my American one in there and I can easily text or call from either. As for the phone... well it does text and snapchat and internet. That's all I ever need it to do. Battery seems strong so far

Works but issues. I bought this phone for my mother who is on Cricket (part of at&t) it gives me an internal error message that it can not complete activation. When I called cricket, the rep said everything is working fine on their end and that the phone was activated. She was able to make and receive calls but text messages, not so much. She could send but only received 1 or 2 out of a dozen sent from various phones. After a factory reset, I still get the internal error message of activation not complete but now she is able to at least receive text messages. I contacted Cricket again and they are saying its a Samsung issue. I've updated the software but its still giving me an error.

Works Well. Works great. Have AT&T and Consumer Cellular chips and have had no issues. If you are concerned about the second SIM using the SD memory slot, there are adapters you can get to solve that problem. Do bear in mind this is a Dual Standby Phone - meaning if one SIM is in use the other SIM does not work at the same time. Ie. if you are on a call from one carrier and a call comes in on the other one it will not notify you while you are on the line. When you hang up you will receive a missed call notification. This is the most common type of Dual SIM phone, but suggest you do you research so you know what you are getting.
Will only work on T-Mobile carriers. This unlocked phone only works on T-Mobile network, starts up with an AT&T splash, and begins setup in Spanish. Not what I was looking for.

Would buy again in the future from these peeps. This was brand new & genuine exactly as described. Seal on the box was not broken. I also received the adaptors for charging huge thanks to the seller for that! I've never purchased unlocked phones or any phone that didn't come from the carrier so I was nervous but it wasn't necessary. Advice for anyone who is a first timer like me for this, be aware you have to sign for the shipment which I didn't realize so I ended up having to pick it up the next day which was fine I saved so much money it was worth it. Works with att, and if you have a nano sim you don't have to get a new sim card just pop the other one in.

Works great with AT&T. Got the phone Nov 1st 2018. Swapped out sim cards from my old S7 and was up an running in about 10min. Just a few settings and that is it. oh... and got a note saying it doesn't work with Verizon or Sprint.
Excellent but doesn't accept a Verizon sim card. I absolutely LOVED this phone but had no idea that a Verizon sim card would not work for it. I had no signal in my area.

Great purchase. Bought this to use in the Caribbean so I needed it unlocked and GSM operating system. This fulfilled both. Battery life is awesome. Haven't used the fingerprint reader as yet but so far an excellent purchase.

I'm using it now to do this review... lol thanks to the seller...

Does not work with verizon. Put that it might not work with my carrier before all the gibberish in the description. My eye skioped over the description because it skips over gibberish. Fix this! Now I have to leave the best tower network in the US and go with something inconvenient.

Does Not Work On Verizon - Given No Prior Warning. I was using this Samsung Galaxy S9 Plus for about 3 months in the New Jersey/New York City area without any issues on Verizon. Now that I am in Florida, the mobile data connection is giving me issues showing that it isn't connected to 4G or LTE, and I come back to read the reviews to find out that this phone does not work on Verizon? After I have been using it on Verizon and it has been working just fine? I have to go out of my way now to switch carriers in order for this phone to work which is absolutely ridiculous.
